activity_baseline.features: historically visible activity counts at each query time

assumptions: Hosted snapshot with record-time filtering; historical relationship changes, deletions and merges remain unresolved.
No raw mutable/text attribute or task target is a node feature; richer historical features are not approved.
Constant encoder statistics are independent of validation; learned preprocessing and baseline fitting use training only.
The 512-query subset is a pilot check, not the final full-validation metric.
The first hosted training run and trained-checkpoint parity remain unvalidated until actual execution.
notes: Measure 100 total reference-training updates before choosing a larger budget. Do not expand this pilot or claim finished quality or trained inference speedup.
